caption: The drawing features a large, beige ceramic barrel with blue decorative elements. The barrel is depicted with a slight three-dimensional perspective, and its surface is adorned with several painted blue illustrations. Around the midsection and upper part of the barrel, there are blue wavy lines encircling it horizontally, with a large fish motif painted prominently on the upper half and a bird below it. On the lowest part of the barrel is another abstract blue motif, possibly a stylized plant or animal. The barrel also has a circular opening fitted with a small spout at the bottom front. Above the barrel, there is a circular object depicting the lid, also beige with blue and brown shading, and inscribed with handwritten text in a dark ink. The background is a plain tan color, and both the barrel and the lid are outlined with fine lines. The artist's signature is located near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Wine Cask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
